aso.content:
#!/bin/bash
# Secure sh
#V
salida="Introduzca la contraseña: "

while IFS= read -p "$salida" -s -n 1 letra
do

    if [[ $letra == 'a' ]] || [[ $letra == $'\0' ]]
    then 
        break
    fi

    salida='*'
    contra+="$letra"
done

echo
echo "La contraseña es: $contra"
